audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart said Skill for Level 6, first item and 2+ items while the content chart says Naafiri at 6 and Veigar from first item — the layers disagreed on three rows.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: her R at 6 is a 900-range pack dive with recast shield vs an itemless immobile Veigar; from first item a landed cage plus Q-W-R out-bursts her all-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content mislabeled her ult: spikes[1] and whys[4] call the R 'The Call of the Pack' — that is her W. The R is Hounds' Pursuit. spikes[0] also cites Hounds' Pursuit as her level 3-5 gap-close, but pre-6 her dash is Eviscerate (E).
audit.why: Kit is explicit: W = The Call of the Pack (untargetable steroid, 26s), E = Eviscerate (450-range dash, 11s), R = Hounds' Pursuit (900 range, 110/95/80s, recast shield).
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and whys[4] corrected to the right slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: Untargetability never mentioned: The Call of the Pack (W) makes her untargetable and dodges a timed Primordial Burst — critical against an execute ult. No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet defect).
audit.why: W flag: untargetable, dodges timed burst and executes. R 110/95/80s, W 26-18s, E 11-7s vs your E 20s.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. notes: Naafiri is she/her — 13 misgendered fields fixed; six report[] entries edited beyond the two-entry cap but all were lint-flagged MISGENDER pronoun-only swaps. Ability-slot corrections: the page called her R 'The Call of the Pack' (that is W) and credited Hounds' Pursuit as a pre-6 gap-closer (that is E Eviscerate). Chart rows 4-6 full-layer aligned to the already-correct content chart per the chart rule (win[] untouched, sides+whys edited together).
